Maya P: Kicking off onboarding plan for new on-call joiners next week. want a short live drill + handoff walkthrough. looking for volunteers to run primary/secondary demos and someone to update the runbook.
Carlos G: I can run the primary demo Thu 09:00 PT. I'll simulate a noisy downstream dependency (DB connection errors) so they learn triage tools.
Nina H: I'll be secondary for that slot. also want to show how we do customer-impact tagging in the incident doc (internal tag: affected_customers).
Tom W: can we make the drill quieter? last time test alerts woke folks up at night. propose: use the simulated channel #eng-oncall-drills and a simulated pager label.
Rina S: yes please. we have an internal endpoint for safe drills: `api.internal/drill-trigger?type=latency&target=model-serving&simulate=true` — use that to create synthetic errors without touching prod metrics.
oncall-bot: Heads-up: Drill scheduled for 2024-09-12 16:00 UTC in #eng-oncall-drills. Reply with :eyes: to confirm.
Maya P: Great. Action items: 1) update runbook page /runbooks/oncall/handoffs.md with clear primary/secondary responsibilities and an abbreviated quick-start checklist; 2) prepare a 10-min demo on using the customer-impact dashboard; 3) set up the drill trigger. who takes which?
Carlos G: I'll take the demo and the simulated alert script. snippet I'll use: ```bash
# simulate high error rate for 3 minutes
curl -X POST "https://api.internal/drill-trigger" -d '{"type":"error_rate","target":"model-server","rate":0.08,"duration":180}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer DRILL-TOKEN'
```
Nina H: I'll update the runbook. plan to add a tiny table: primary vs secondary tasks + 3-step handoff template. will push a PR and tag folks.
Tom W: During the session let's practice a live handoff. structure: incoming page -> primary triages and posts initial status -> secondary executes a mitigation command -> both confirm impact and update incident doc -> handoff at 30min if not resolved.
Rina S: Mitigation examples to demo: 1) scale up replicas `kubectl scale deployment model-server --replicas=6 -n inference` 2) enable model fallback via feature flag `redwoodctl flag set fallback_enabled true` 3) add Alertmanager silence `alertmanager silence add --matchers route=api/model --duration=20m`
Maya P: Important: include customer-impact assessment steps explicitly in the runbook: how to check per-customer error rates, how to set severity, and when to page product ops. 
Nina H: I'll add this checklist: `impact-checklist: check-dashboard | query-customer-errors | estimate-affected-percent | set-severity | notify-sales` — pasteable into incident notes.
Carlos G: For the simulated incident I'll trigger this alert: `MODEL_ERROR_RATE > 5% over 2 mins`. We'll then walk through: check traces, run mitigation 1 (scale), mitigation 2 (fallback), and if not resolved, rollback model image.
Tom W: Also show them how to mute the drill channel on their phone so they don't get duplicate notifications, and how to leave a short sticky note in the incident doc like: `SIMULATED DRILL — no customer impact`.
Rina S: small ops tip: new oncallers forget to check the autoscaler logs. command: `kubectl logs deploy/model-server -c autoscaler -n inference --tail=200 | grep scale` — helps spot why scaling may have failed.
Maya P: Let's pick the new oncaller to shadow: @Sam will be our new hire. plan: Sam shadows first 45 mins, then flips to primary under supervision for 30 mins. Sam can practice running `redwoodctl rollback --to stable` in the sandbox.
oncall-bot: Drill created (simulated): #drill-2432111111 by Carlos G 8:00. Channel: #eng-oncall-drills.
Nina H: Cool. I'll open the PR to /docs/runbooks/handoffs.md now and tag @MayaP @CarlosG for review. aiming to merge by EOD tomorrow so we have material to read before the drill.
Carlos G: one more: let's add a tiny mental-model short note for newbies: when to pick fallback vs scale vs rollback — keep it to 3 bullets: expected recovery time, customer-experience risk, and deploy risk.
Tom W: Agree. I'll prepare a 3-slide explainer and a one-liner cheat sheet they can paste into Slack during incidents.
Maya P: Perfect. please react with availability. I'll send calendar invites to #eng-oncall-drills and include the runbook PR link. Thanks all :raised_hands:
